question: Can causal daily EMA/MACD warnings identify major AMZN reversals, and which parameters merit a selectable research preset?
indicatorImplementation: Reuse native-chart.js indicators.ema and indicators.macd unchanged; SMA-seeded EMA, complete prefix history before evaluation dates.
signalRule: At each completed daily close: bullish if EMA fast > slow and MACD line > signal; bearish if both inequalities reverse. Mixed readings retain the last state. Emit only changes between established bull/bear states; initialization emits no warning. No future price enters indicators or signals.
controls: MACD12/26/9 histogram rising/falling for three consecutive changes
swingBenchmark: 15% close-based directional-change ZigZag. Retain extreme date and later threshold-confirmation date; never feed labels into the signal. This is a hindsight evaluation oracle, not a tradable entry rule. Final unconfirmed extreme is not scored.

matching.direction: Bull warning to trough; bear warning to peak
matching.algorithm: One warning and one same-direction pivot per match; ordered dynamic programming maximizes cardinality then minimizes total absolute trading-bar lag. Deterministic tie breaks.
matching.partitionBoundary: A pivot is eligible only if its entire -10/+20 matching window and its confirmation date lie inside that partition. Report excluded pivots. All partition warning dates remain in the precision denominator; unmatched boundary warnings are counted conservatively.

selection.trainRanking: Eligible <=8 annual flips, descending timely F1, then lower unmatched warnings/year, lower median absolute pivot lag, stable ID.
selection.validationChoice: Choose once among the frozen training top5, subject to <=8 annual flips, by the same ranking. No holdout value participates in selection. If no eligible candidate exists, report that instead of silently relaxing the limit.
selection.holdout: After writing selection.json, evaluate only the selected candidate and fixed controls. Evaluate 10%/20% sensitivity without retuning.

limits: No return/CAGR/profit claims; no execution, costs, positions or shorting simulated. No parameter guarantees all swings. Lead before hindsight extrema is different from detection before confirmation. <=8 flips/year is a research filter, not a user trade-frequency promise.
appWarmup: Compare selected indicator values using all available history versus only the latest500 daily bars at the same completed date before claiming app/study equivalence.
repository: No Git repository exists; no branch can be created without initializing one. Preserve source and configuration SHA256 identities instead; production app edits follow existing tests.
